body: You agreed last week to refund $120. It hasn't shown up yet. Was it sent to the card that's now closed?

subject: Report scheduling

subject: Can't log in on the new laptop

subject: Year-end close button greyed out

subject: Pay by bank transfer

subject: Pricing for a holding company

subject: Stolen laptop with saved login
body: Our bookkeeper's laptop was stolen from her car an hour ago and the app was logged in. Please sign her out everywhere and stop any sessions right now.
